_meta.scope: Re-solve of chosen poses of production PathSolver cells (outdoor scenes) with the production scene, placement and solver call; lists every returned path. Simulation bookkeeping only: no RF measurement comparison; differences between poses are observations of the solver output and are not called solver faults. A run with spp or device different from production cannot reproduce E_stored.
reused_by_import: elevation_sweep_md.main (argument parser; run swapped for a capture)
elevation_sweep_md.carrier, env_parts, build_scene_builtin, require_cuda_variant, shard_done, SOLVER_BUILD, TJ
report15_probe.place, unpack, build_scene (via Part), NO_OBJ, MAX_PATHS, rt, mi

copied.what: drone spec, FastPoser, PRF, pose count, azimuth, rpm and rotor phases (constant-rpm branch)
ray count, depth and --sw switch parsing (--sw branch only)
per-pose vertex update and drone Part list (in-memory branch)
environment scene (outdoor01_* meshes or NVIDIA built-in scene)
per-pose object_id -> scene object name map
interaction mask and carrier-phase sum (no --det branch)

definitions.cell complex median m: median(Re E) + 1j*median(Im E) over all poses of the merged stored field.
definitions.scale: median over poses of |E - m| (stored field).
definitions.isolated pose: |E - m| > factor * scale on the stored field (factor 20 as in the ledger's primary factor).
definitions.roles: isolated = among the first n_outliers isolated poses; neighbour = pose i-1 or i+1 of a chosen isolated pose; random = drawn without replacement from poses that are neither isolated nor chosen, generator numpy default_rng(seeds.random_pose_draw + cell index). A pose can carry several roles.
definitions.E_recomputed: sum over paths with at least one interaction of a*exp(-j*2*pi*fc*tau), path order as returned (elevation_sweep_md.py:1124-1125, 1144-1145).
definitions.a_bb: a*exp(-j*2*pi*fc*tau) per path (the production summand); a is the solver's passband coefficient.
definitions.rel_diff_stored_vs_repeat: |E_stored - E_rep1| / |E_stored| for the stored repeat run (_rep1) of the same cell when it exists: run-to-run spread of production at that pose.
definitions.objects: scene object name per interaction, from the per-pose object_id -> name map (elevation_sweep_md.py:1087-1088); drone parts are the Part names <drone>_<group> placed in the scene, every other mapped name is an environment object.
definitions.unnamed[r]: an object without a name in a built-in scene; Mitsuba calls it no-name-<counter> and the counter grows with every scene load, so the listing uses r = rank of the counter within the pose's scene; the raw names are kept per pose in unnamed_raw_names.
definitions.path classes: none = no interaction (not in E); env_only = only environment objects; drone_only = only drone parts; both = at least one of each; unmapped = an object id missing from the pose's map.
definitions.path key: per interaction (object name, interaction type, primitive index); used to match a path between poses together with |delay difference| <= tau_tol_s.
definitions.class_differing_most: for an isolated pose i with non-isolated computed neighbours N: the class c maximising |S_c(i) - mean_{j in N} S_c(j)|, S_c = complex class sum; None (counted as all_zero) when every class difference is zero.
definitions.fraction_isolated_where_neighbours_stron: over isolated poses with at least one non-isolated neighbour carrying an environment-only path: share of isolated poses at which the strongest environment-only path of every such neighbour has no match.
definitions.control_fraction_left_neighbour_stronges: for isolated poses with two non-isolated neighbours: share where the strongest environment-only path of pose i-1 has a match at pose i+1 (two poses apart, no isolated label).
definitions.random_control: most common strongest environment-only path key among random poses and the share of random poses where that path has a match.
definitions.production_equivalent: device variant is CUDA and the ray count equals the arm's ray count.

assumptions: The production pose loop builds the in-memory drone meshes from the shard's first pose and replaces the vertices before every solve; this script starts the cache from its first solved pose.

The production process solved thousands of poses before a given pose; this process solves few. Mitsuba object ids differ with that history; the equivalence check against E_stored measures whether that matters.
Accessing Paths.interactions, primitives and vertices after unpack does not change a or tau.
